about: Where a new folder named on a runner goes: newFolderRootFor and newFolderPath (dto.ts). The server makes the
workspace there (POST /sessions newWorkspace.newFolder, POST /workspaces newFolder) and every client's setup card
shows and probes the same path, so all of them are held to these cases. `capabilities` is what the runner has
reported ([] before it reports); `root` null means it cannot make a new folder; `path` is `root` joined with `app`.

cases.name: a managed runner that has not reported yet takes its image's home
a managed runner that has not reported ignores a Repos Folder stored from before
a managed runner that reported is read as any machine: no Repos Folder, no new folder
a managed runner that reported is read as any machine: too old, no new folder
a managed runner that reported makes it in its home
a machine that makes folders in its home
an older machine makes them in its Repos Folder
a Windows machine keeps its separator
a Repos Folder at the top of the disk sits in its root
a machine too old to make folders makes none
a machine that has not reported its Repos Folder makes none
